messages.ability.assassin-e.description: Blink toward the aim point, briefly evade damage and strike nearby enemies.
messages.ability.assassin-e.name: Shadow Step
messages.ability.assassin-q.description: New aimed attacks cannot target you. Existing hazards still hurt.
messages.ability.assassin-q.name: Invisibility
messages.ability.assassin-ultimate.description: For 5 seconds, gain three free empowered Shadow Steps, 100% critical chance and protection from new aimed attacks. Existing hazards remain dangerous outside dodge invulnerability.
messages.ability.assassin-ultimate.name: Unwritten Passage
messages.ability.engineer-e.description: Deploy a 120-health barrier that blocks hostile bullets. Teammates can pass through it.
messages.ability.engineer-e.name: Deployable Barricade
messages.ability.engineer-q.description: Deploy an 80-health turret with 25 base damage per second.
messages.ability.engineer-q.name: Rivet Turret
messages.ability.engineer-ultimate.description: Deploy a 200-health siege construct with 90 base damage per second for 14 seconds. Your turrets gain 50% output.
messages.ability.engineer-ultimate.name: Impossible Machine
messages.ability.heavy-e.description: Gain 45% damage resistance and 30% fire rate for 5 seconds; move at 60% speed.
messages.ability.heavy-e.name: Braced Firing
messages.ability.heavy-q.description: Fire fourteen rounds in a cone and slow ordinary enemies by 40%.
messages.ability.heavy-q.name: Suppressing Cone
messages.ability.heavy-ultimate.description: For 6 seconds, gain 70% fire rate and two extra pierces without consuming the magazine. Movement is reduced.
messages.ability.heavy-ultimate.name: Foundry Overture
messages.ability.mage-e.description: Detonate a ward at the aim point and grant nearby allies 35 shield.
messages.ability.mage-e.name: Ward Detonation
messages.ability.mage-q.description: Damage enemies within a sigil and slow ordinary enemies by 55%.
messages.ability.mage-q.name: Binding Sigil
messages.ability.mage-ultimate.description: Release three 120-damage pulses over 3 seconds. The first clears hostile projectiles in range; ordinary enemies are strongly slowed.
messages.ability.mage-ultimate.name: Silent Twelfth
messages.ability.medic-e.description: Heal nearby allies for 20 health and remove poison and slow effects.
messages.ability.medic-e.name: Cleansing Serum
messages.ability.medic-q.description: Restore 8 health per second to allies inside the field.
messages.ability.medic-q.name: Healing Field
messages.ability.medic-ultimate.description: After a one-second channel, revive nearby downed or eliminated allies under the selected difficulty’s revive rules. Heal living allies for 40, cleanse effects and deal 35 damage nearby. Solo also gains 40 shield.
messages.ability.medic-ultimate.name: Names Returned
messages.ability.soldier-e.description: Fire three accurate piercing rounds toward the aim point.
messages.ability.soldier-e.name: Precision Burst
messages.ability.soldier-q.description: Allies in the field gain 20% weapon damage and 10% movement speed.
messages.ability.soldier-q.name: Rally Field
messages.ability.soldier-ultimate.description: Instantly reload allies, clear nearby hostile projectiles once, and grant 35% weapon damage in the field for 8 seconds.
messages.ability.soldier-ultimate.name: Last Roll Call
messages.ability.tank-e.description: Charge toward the aim point, briefly evade damage and strike nearby enemies.
messages.ability.tank-e.name: Rescue Charge
messages.ability.tank-q.description: Place a 150-health wall that blocks hostile bullets. Allies can walk through it.
messages.ability.tank-q.name: Protective Wall
messages.ability.tank-ultimate.description: Nearby allies gain 120 shield and 35 percentage points of armor for 8 seconds. Armor respects the global cap; identical fields do not stack.
messages.ability.tank-ultimate.name: The City Holds
messages.arena.bell-foundry.description: Cold brass bells and enormous molds create cover islands and four broad exits.
messages.arena.bell-foundry.name: Bell Foundry
messages.arena.crown-crypt.description: A drowned council chamber beneath hollow bells, with an open outer ring.
messages.arena.crown-crypt.name: Crown Crypt
messages.arena.gatehouse.description: Broken civic gates and an empty fountain, with broad outer-wall lanes.
messages.arena.gatehouse.name: Gatehouse
messages.arena.ossuary-works.description: Mortuary machines and bone crates divide diagonal fire corridors.
messages.arena.ossuary-works.name: Ossuary Works
messages.arena.sunken-chapel.description: Floodwater surrounds stone walks and a cracked altar. Water margins are clearly marked.
messages.arena.sunken-chapel.name: Sunken Chapel
messages.arena.triage-yard.description: Abandoned hospital tents and quiet cots, with wide rescue paths.
messages.arena.triage-yard.name: Triage Yard
messages.attack.armor.description: Damage resistance rises briefly. Save burst attacks for the opening afterward.
messages.attack.armor.name: Armored stance
messages.attack.beam.description: A marked line becomes a damaging beam after the warning.
messages.attack.beam.name: Beam
messages.attack.charge.description: The boss rushes along a marked path after a warning.
messages.attack.charge.name: Charge
messages.attack.cross.description: Intersecting projectile lanes sweep across the arena.
messages.attack.cross.name: Crossing trails
messages.attack.fan.description: A spread of aimed projectiles. Leave the marked cone before it fires.
messages.attack.fan.name: Fan volley
messages.attack.hook.description: A targeted hook threatens isolated survivors. Avoid its marked path.
messages.attack.hook.name: Hook
messages.attack.lanes.description: Parallel projectile lanes leave alternating safe passages.
messages.attack.lanes.name: Barrage lanes
messages.attack.pool.description: A marked patch becomes a lingering damage zone.
messages.attack.pool.name: Contaminated pool
messages.attack.pulse.description: A short-range shock spreads from the boss. Move beyond the marked radius.
messages.attack.pulse.name: Shock pulse
messages.attack.ring.description: Projectiles expand from the boss. Use the visible gap or dodge at the right moment.
messages.attack.ring.name: Expanding ring
messages.attack.spiral.description: Rotating projectile streams leave moving escape lanes.
messages.attack.spiral.name: Spiral
messages.attack.summon.description: Additional enemies appear after a marked warning.
messages.attack.summon.name: Summon
messages.attack.tether.description: A binding link pressures the squad to move together and help trapped allies.
messages.attack.tether.name: Tether
messages.attack.warp.description: The boss changes position after a warning. Watch the destination.
messages.attack.warp.name: Warp
messages.attack.zone.description: Marked areas become damaging arrest zones. Leave them before the warning ends.
messages.attack.zone.name: Arrest zone
messages.boss.alchemist.description: Flasks aim at survivors and mark their landing for 1.4 seconds. Acid and alkali both hurt and slow. Their mixture clears the reagents into coolant that absorbs vapor and cools vessels. Coolant is a reaction product, not a pickup.
messages.boss.alchemist.name: Mold Alchemist
messages.boss.anatomist.description: Delayed calipers strike two locked positions. Leave the fixed circles after the target-lock icon changes.
messages.boss.anatomist.name: The Anatomist
messages.boss.ash-baker.description: Slow loaves split into two crumbs after landing. Avoid the landing circles and both marked split directions.
messages.boss.ash-baker.name: Ash Baker
messages.boss.bell-triplets.description: Three keepers cast in turns. Hit the highlighted keeper to interrupt a beam; a fixed safe gap always remains.
messages.boss.bell-triplets.name: Bell Triplets
messages.boss.bellringer.description: Standard peals leave a fixed 46-degree opening; advanced forms leave 35 degrees. Keep your whole body inside the gap or cross a front with a dash. The pale approach path is harmless. Each moving front and clapper swing hits once.
messages.boss.bellringer.name: Bellringer
messages.boss.black-ambulance.description: The Ambulance follows a connected perimeter route, then charges a fixed road. Gold patrol marks are harmless; the broad road warning is dangerous only after release. Cover and actual arena boundaries constrain its body. After the last dispatch the driver is exposed for three seconds, taking 25% extra boss damage.
messages.boss.black-ambulance.name: Black Ambulance
messages.boss.boiler-tender.description: Three valves build pressure. Hold any neutral valve to vent a safe wedge, or use the marked outer gap.
messages.boss.boiler-tender.name: Boiler Tender
messages.boss.bridge-ferryman.description: Two bridges alternate over dangerous water bands. Follow the open arrow or take the safe outer bypass.
messages.boss.bridge-ferryman.name: Bridge Ferryman
messages.boss.canal-diver.description: It vanishes into three puddles and emerges where bubbles appear first. Leave that ring, then attack during resurfacing recovery.
messages.boss.canal-diver.name: Canal Diver
messages.boss.chain-colossus.description: Three pylons pull a marked floor section. Destroy any pylon for a damage opening, or use the clear outer lane.
messages.boss.chain-colossus.name: Chain Colossus
messages.boss.chain-marshal.description: Two numbered anchors warn opposite locked sweeps. Leave the painted sector, cross behind the passing arm or shoot an anchor to cut that arm. Clear masonry stops the chain.
messages.boss.chain-marshal.name: Chain Marshal
messages.boss.chalk-magistrate.description: A rectangle closes with three flashing walls and one erased wall. Cross the erased side during the warning; walls never physically trap you.
messages.boss.chalk-magistrate.name: Chalk Magistrate
messages.boss.choir-of-moths.description: Three curved moth ribbons leave one visibly broken crossing. Cross at that break rather than through the intact ribbons.
messages.boss.choir-of-moths.name: Choir of Moths
messages.boss.choir.description: Undead singers coordinate beams and intersecting attacks. Move before the marked notes become hazards.
messages.boss.choir.name: Grave Choir
messages.boss.cinder-foreman.description: Three work zones prepare to vent. Use the neutral cooling switch or the naturally safe third sector.
messages.boss.cinder-foreman.name: Cinder Foreman
messages.boss.city-eater.description: Two bite lanes leave one broad escape corridor. Use the unmarked corridor and attack in recovery; break temporary walls to expose the core.
messages.boss.city-eater.name: City Eater
messages.boss.clockmender.description: A slow bullet ring stops, then resumes in the same direction. Cross while it is stationary before the three-beat cue ends.
messages.boss.clockmender.name: Clockmender
messages.boss.constable.description: A dead watch captain fires aimed volleys and enclosing rings. Watch for marked arrest zones.
messages.boss.constable.name: Hollow Constable
messages.boss.courier.description: A single delivery becomes two charges at half health. Dodge each fixed lane sideways, avoid fading trails, and punish the final stop.
messages.boss.courier.name: Carrion Courier
messages.boss.crow-shepherd.description: Three cohesive bird flocks cross marked trails. Read the dashed paths and cross behind the leading bird.
messages.boss.crow-shepherd.name: Crow Shepherd
messages.boss.crown-procession.description: Four attendants carry a moving throne. Defeat any attendant to lower it, or attack during the scheduled throne rest.
messages.boss.crown-procession.name: Crown Procession
messages.boss.engine.description: An armored machine seals its weak points between barrages. Reserve damage for exposed phases.
messages.boss.engine.name: Mortuary Engine
messages.boss.folded-man.description: A floor fold reflects bullets once at a mirrored angle. Read both predicted path segments or stay on the unreflected side.
messages.boss.folded-man.name: Folded Man
messages.boss.gate-widow.description: Two lanes close; the numbered opening stays passable. A moving floor pall follows the two closed tracks. Enter the open lane or time a dash through the pall. Walls do not stop this floor sweep.
messages.boss.gate-widow.name: Gate Widow
messages.boss.glass-surgeon.description: Glass needles form a dangerous polygon with one missing edge. Escape through that opening before activation.
messages.boss.glass-surgeon.name: Glass Surgeon
messages.boss.gravedigger.description: A moving earth ridge blocks hostile bullets, then collapses into pits. Take cover briefly and leave the marked collapse path.
messages.boss.gravedigger.name: Gravedigger
messages.boss.hourglass-widow.description: A slow fan replays the same path after a countdown. Follow the dashed replay paths or use the persistent safe flank.
messages.boss.hourglass-widow.name: Hourglass Widow
messages.boss.ice-custodian.description: Three icy strips cause bounded sideways sliding. Stay on dry strips; normal dodging remains available.
messages.boss.ice-custodian.name: Ice Custodian
messages.boss.ink-notary.description: An incomplete ink spiral hardens into danger. Exit through its visible mouth before activation rather than crossing the stroke.
messages.boss.ink-notary.name: Ink Notary
messages.boss.lamplighter.description: Three candles cast safe shadow pockets before a pulse. Enter an outlined pocket and stay within its boundary.
messages.boss.lamplighter.name: The Lamplighter
messages.boss.lantern-warden.description: Read the sweep arrow and stay behind the cone. At half health the Warden patrols between sweeps; its dangerous ground origin stays locked.
messages.boss.lantern-warden.name: Lantern Warden
messages.boss.last-breath-saint.description: Inhalation pulls gently before slow exhaled rings. Use either shelter pad or steer outward; solo needs only one pad.
messages.boss.last-breath-saint.name: Saint of the Last Breath
messages.boss.last-knocker.description: Three visible knocks precede a marked door swing. Move behind the hinge and attack during the open-door recovery.
messages.boss.last-knocker.name: The Last Knocker
messages.boss.ledger-leech.description: Paper seals slow marked players. Walk through either cleansing circle or wait for the bounded slow to expire; currency is never stolen.
messages.boss.ledger-leech.name: Ledger Leech
messages.boss.matron.description: The Matron walks along a body-clear route to a marked nest. Up to three nests call bounded broods after a 1.2-second warning. Destroying a nest stops its future brood and unreleased needles. The early lullaby comes from the new nest; the late phase relays through surviving nests with 1.6-second warnings. If none survive, the Matron calls alone. Cross the visible gaps; launched rings continue.
messages.boss.matron.name: Cradle Matron
messages.boss.memory-taxer.description: Three symbols identify safe pads before a pulse. Choose the first shown symbol using the visible HUD history; memorization is optional.
messages.boss.memory-taxer.name: Memory Taxer
messages.boss.mirror-undertaker.description: A harmless reflection copies an earlier position. Find the real body by its black foot marker and ignore the hollow outline.
messages.boss.mirror-undertaker.name: Mirror Undertaker
messages.boss.ossuary-leviathan.description: Three ribs become weak points in numbered order. Focus the exposed rib and stay outside the thick body outline.
messages.boss.ossuary-leviathan.name: Ossuary Leviathan
messages.boss.pallbearer.description: A coffin-bearing brute advances behind armor, then charges. Use the moving cover and strike during openings.
messages.boss.pallbearer.name: Pallbearer
messages.boss.plague-gardener.description: Four radial vines grow, then one becomes a healing path. Use the cut strip or destroy a root to shorten growth.
messages.boss.plague-gardener.name: Plague Gardener
messages.boss.porcelain-mourner.description: Four mask fragments move as cover, then crack into radial hazards. Leave a fragment when its cracking warning begins.
messages.boss.porcelain-mourner.name: Porcelain Mourner
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.description: Three ordered stamps use reachable clear ground. The notched seal reopens after the sequence: stamp I first phase, stamp III after a short delay later. Wait for green before entering. The green shield stops the warned volley from the two red seals, letting you keep firing. Bullets break on its rim; the outer ring counts down until shelter closes. You can also dodge outside.
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.name: Quarantine Clerk
messages.boss.quarantine-heart.description: Four hoses stream toward the walls. Hold a neutral valve to reverse a stream into the core, or attack from the open side.
messages.boss.quarantine-heart.name: Quarantine Heart
messages.boss.ratcatcher.description: Three scent lanes release up to twelve rats. At half health the Ratcatcher relocates before the next full warning. Cross the lanes or shoot the sack to cancel a pack.
messages.boss.ratcatcher.name: Ratcatcher
messages.boss.red-abbess.description: Two moving sanctuaries protect against an inward wave. Reach either sanctuary and hold its neutralizing pad.
messages.boss.red-abbess.name: Red Abbess
messages.boss.red-comet.description: Three waypoint dashes leave trails that fade in creation order. Follow the numbers and cross the oldest faded trail.
messages.boss.red-comet.name: Red Comet
messages.boss.regent.description: The dead ruler shifts position and floods the arena. Read the transformation warnings before committing.
messages.boss.regent.name: Drowned Regent
messages.boss.salt-patriarch.description: A salt boundary advances inward in three steps. Use either broad gate; an Accord pad can briefly delay the next step.
messages.boss.salt-patriarch.name: Salt Patriarch
messages.boss.sluice-keeper.description: Alternating currents push sideways without damage. Use the dry raised strips or steer against the current while dodging bullets.
messages.boss.sluice-keeper.name: Sluice Keeper
messages.boss.spore-beekeeper.description: Three drones prepare a swarm. Destroy one to open a wedge, or use the permanent fallback gap.
messages.boss.spore-beekeeper.name: Spore Beekeeper
messages.boss.stationmaster.description: Signals alternate danger between two rail lanes. Follow the cross and arrow symbols, not color alone.
messages.boss.stationmaster.name: Last Stationmaster
messages.boss.stitchwright.description: Hooks and tethers turn isolated survivors into targets. Keep a rescue route open.
messages.boss.stitchwright.name: Stitchwright
messages.boss.tollkeeper.description: A coin wheel rolls to a wall and returns. Standard Exact Fare locks the complete reflected route before release. Closing Booth relocates first and locks its return only after the bank stop. Each new heading warns before moving.
messages.boss.tollkeeper.name: The Tollkeeper
messages.boss.uncounted.description: The bells remember erased names. Survive spirals, beams, summons and warps in a secret final test.
messages.boss.uncounted.name: The Uncounted
messages.boss.unlit-astronomer.description: Two orbiting hazards surround a harmless safe marker. Follow the hollow marker's orbit and avoid the solid hazards.
messages.boss.unlit-astronomer.name: Unlit Astronomer
messages.boss.vesper-judge.description: A verdict marks one arena half for a strike. Cross the center during the warning; the other half remains open.
messages.boss.vesper-judge.name: Vesper Judge
messages.boss.walking-district.description: Two building blocks shift along marked lanes and expose the core. Take the outer bypass or the cleared center after they settle.
messages.boss.walking-district.name: Walking District
messages.boss.wire-harpist.description: Three strings strike in numbered low-middle-high order. Move between lanes using the dashed next-string cue and visible countdown.
messages.boss.wire-harpist.name: Wire Harpist
messages.boss.wire-seamstress.description: Three anchors form a zigzag fence with one stable doorway. Use the doorway or break an anchor to remove its wire.
messages.boss.wire-seamstress.name: Seamstress of Wires
messages.boss.zero-hour-conductor.description: Four visible beats release alternating lane attacks. Follow the beat pips and safe-lane marker; hearing the rhythm is unnecessary.
messages.boss.zero-hour-conductor.name: Zero-Hour Conductor
messages.class.assassin.lore: Vale carried letters through streets the watch had abandoned. They still know the alleys that lead home.
messages.class.assassin.name: Assassin
messages.class.engineer.lore: Tamsin repairs tools with mismatched parts. She believes the city can be repaired too.
messages.class.engineer.name: Engineer
messages.class.heavy.lore: Hux carries the foundry's last functioning feed motor into the streets.
messages.class.heavy.name: Heavy
messages.class.mage.lore: Sable studied forbidden bell harmonics. The cure and curse share a notebook.
messages.class.mage.name: Mage
messages.class.mage.role: Area control and magical burst damage.
messages.class.medic.lore: Iona wrote names on bandages when paper ran out. The bells will not erase them.
messages.class.medic.name: Medic
messages.class.soldier.lore: Mara refused to bar the infirmary doors. She counts everyone before she moves.
messages.class.soldier.name: Soldier
messages.class.soldier.role: Reliable ranged damage and squad leadership.
messages.class.tank.lore: Bram carries a door that outlived its building. A shield needs someone behind it.
messages.class.tank.name: Tank
messages.mode.endless.description: Survive successive bosses with no final round. Vote, shop and reinforce between encounters while danger keeps escalating. Supports solo play and groups of up to fifty.
messages.mode.endless.name: Endless Vigil
messages.mode.long.description: Sixteen encounters across every district, with champions and additional survivor testimony.
messages.mode.long.name: Black Bell Pilgrimage
messages.mode.raid.description: Three extended boss encounters for up to sixteen players, with accelerated builds and larger cooperative objectives.
messages.mode.raid.name: Grand Raid
messages.mode.short.description: Five contracts from the breached gate to the drowned council chamber. A compact complete campaign.
messages.mode.short.name: Quarantine Run
messages.mode.standard.description: Ten contracts around the quarantined city, with a full build and a final confrontation.
messages.mode.standard.name: Midnight Circuit

messages.boss.ashen-usher.name: Ashen Usher
messages.boss.ashen-usher.description: Ticket stands fire locked volleys. Break a stand or cross after its shots. Later calls cross the rows and repeat the sweep.
messages.boss.ashen-usher.brutalHelp: Brutal adds a third stand behind the target and a delayed closing volley.
messages.boss.brass-toad.name: Brass Toad
messages.boss.brass-toad.description: Leave the marked landing, then cross the ripple gap. Later phases add a second hop and a locked tongue lane. Break the drain plug to stop the tongue.
messages.boss.brass-toad.brutalHelp: Brutal adds a delayed ripple after each landing; the last phase has three hops.
messages.boss.ragpicker-kite.name: Ragpicker's Kite
messages.boss.ragpicker-kite.description: Follow wind arrows or use the quiet center. Break a pin to remove its corridor. Later phases add opposing wind and staggered wing fans. Dodge ignores wind briefly.
messages.boss.ragpicker-kite.brutalHelp: Brutal adds a diagonal wind corridor and a final gapped ring.

messages.ui.brutalWaves: Brutal: 2.5× Standard projectiles plus extra patterns. Crazed: 3× Brutal projectiles (7.5× Standard), with pursuit marks and crossing weaves. Safety caps still apply.
messages.ui.reviveRulesHelp: Self-revival uses a charge and a two-second channel. Medics can use it in a team; other classes only in Solo. Health recovers between fights.

messages.ui.lavaHelp: Lava: keep off the marked pits.
messages.talent.breach-cadence.name: Breach Cadence
messages.talent.breach-cadence.description: E fires three locked-aim shots 0.12 s apart; total damage stays the same.
messages.talent.supply-line.name: Supply Line
messages.talent.supply-line.description: Ultimate refills ammo again halfway through its field; its base damage bonus falls from 35% to 25%.
messages.talent.marching-colors.name: Marching Colors
messages.talent.marching-colors.description: Q follows you, with 25% less radius.
messages.talent.shoulder-mantlet.name: Shoulder Mantlet
messages.talent.shoulder-mantlet.description: E adds a moving 80-base-health front wall; base brace reduction falls from 45% to 25%.
messages.talent.furnace-vents.name: Furnace Vents
messages.talent.furnace-vents.description: Ultimate vents eight short-range shots every two seconds after the first second; base fire-rate bonus falls from 70% to 40%.
messages.talent.split-suppression.name: Split Suppression
messages.talent.split-suppression.description: Q divides the same fourteen pellets into two narrow cones with a gap in front.
messages.talent.wake-guard.name: Wake Guard
messages.talent.wake-guard.description: Charge leaves an 80-base-health wall for two seconds at departure.
messages.talent.procession.name: Procession
messages.talent.procession.description: Ultimate follows you and shields each entrant once for 90 base health instead of 120.
messages.talent.cornerstone.name: Cornerstone
messages.talent.cornerstone.description: Q splits its wall into two angled panels, each with half the original health and length.
messages.talent.serum-relay.name: Serum Relay
messages.talent.serum-relay.description: E chains heals and cleansing to three distinct allies, within 140 per hop, instead of every nearby ally.
messages.talent.second-breath.name: Second Breath
messages.talent.second-breath.description: Ultimate trades 40 instant base healing for 24 plus three healing pulses of 6. Difficulty revival rules still apply.
messages.talent.field-triage.name: Field Triage
messages.talent.field-triage.description: Q follows the most injured nearby ally, with 25% less radius.
messages.talent.ward-echo.name: Ward Echo
messages.talent.ward-echo.description: E splits its 65 base damage into 40 now and 25 at the same ground point after 0.75 s.
messages.talent.orbit-requiem.name: Orbit Requiem
messages.talent.orbit-requiem.description: Ultimate replaces its large fixed pulse with three smaller orbiting centers, each dealing one third of the pulse damage.
messages.talent.twin-sigils.name: Twin Sigils
messages.talent.twin-sigils.description: Q makes two separated smaller sigils, each dealing half damage.
messages.talent.return-current.name: Return Current
messages.talent.return-current.description: Barricade stores up to 120 absorbed damage; destruction or expiry releases 60% of it nearby.
messages.talent.foundry-relay.name: Foundry Relay
messages.talent.foundry-relay.description: Siege follows at 160 pixels per second; base health falls from 200 to 160.
messages.talent.crossfire-pair.name: Crossfire Pair
messages.talent.crossfire-pair.description: Q makes two turrets with half health and damage each; the second prefers a farther target.
messages.talent.aftercut.name: Aftercut
messages.talent.aftercut.description: Step deals 60% damage now and 40% along its locked path after 0.45 s.
messages.talent.unwritten-traps.name: Unwritten Traps
messages.talent.unwritten-traps.description: Ultimate lasts 3.5 s with one fewer free step; empowered departures leave three damaging pulses.
messages.talent.decoy-veil.name: Decoy Veil
messages.talent.decoy-veil.description: Q leaves a 60-health projectile-damageable decoy that attracts aim; base veil duration falls from 6 s to 4 s.
messages.boss.lantern-warden.phaseHint.0: Follow the arrow behind the cone. The Warden holds still through its warning and sweep.
messages.boss.lantern-warden.phaseHint.1: The Warden patrols before the next warning. Follow the new ground origin, then move behind the cone.
messages.boss.lantern-warden.brutalHelp: Brutal alternates sweep direction and repeats recovery volleys. The final phase adds a fully warned return sweep; active sweeps never overlap.
messages.boss.candle-snail.name: Candle Snail
messages.boss.candle-snail.phaseHint.0: Leave the marked wax before it burns. Masonry stops the wake.
messages.boss.candle-snail.phaseHint.1: Twin rails leave a quiet center; the snail glides faster.
messages.boss.candle-snail.description: Leave the marked wax before it burns. Masonry stops the wake. Twin rails leave a quiet center; the snail glides faster.
messages.boss.candle-snail.brutalHelp: Brutal adds a delayed cross-cut and two warned projectile waves.
messages.boss.cobble-crab.name: Cobble Crab
messages.boss.cobble-crab.phaseHint.0: Leave the marked closing jaws, or break their linked anchor stone.
messages.boss.cobble-crab.phaseHint.1: Clamps alternate axes and close twice. The anchor cancels its linked pair.
messages.boss.cobble-crab.description: Leave the marked closing jaws, or break their linked anchor stone. Clamps alternate axes and close twice. The anchor cancels its linked pair.
messages.boss.cobble-crab.brutalHelp: Brutal adds a separate anchor, another closure and two projectile waves.
messages.boss.mourning-kettle.name: Mourning Kettle
messages.boss.mourning-kettle.phaseHint.0: Sidestep the steam warning. Beads cross after it ends; break a valve to cancel its pour.
messages.boss.mourning-kettle.phaseHint.1: Two spaced lanes pour in sequence, leaving a cold center.
messages.boss.mourning-kettle.description: Sidestep the steam warning. Beads cross after it ends; break a valve to cancel its pour. Two spaced lanes pour in sequence, leaving a cold center.
messages.boss.mourning-kettle.brutalHelp: Brutal adds a delayed rear pour and two bead waves. Keep a cold route.
messages.ui.crazedInfo: 7.5× Standard projectiles · pursuit marks and crossing weaves · no phase shield event
messages.ui.variantPressureHelp: Leave the locked circles before they fill. Cross the marked lane during its warning; Crazed adds a delayed perpendicular cut.
messages.ui.endlessForms: Endless repeats each identity as Standard, then Brutal, then Crazed after successful clears. Insane forces Brutal; Hellish forces Crazed.
messages.ui.crazedHelp: Purple Crazed form adds a delayed crossing weave. Keep moving when pursuit marks lock onto your position.
messages.ui.forcedFormHelp: Insane fixes the boss form to Brutal. Hellish fixes it to Crazed. Other difficulties use this choice for the first boss only.
messages.boss.courier.phaseHint.0: Dodge the fixed charge lane, then punish the stop. The narrow trail fades behind the Courier.
messages.boss.courier.phaseHint.1: A second charge warns from the first stop. Read each new arrow; attack after the final delivery.
messages.boss.courier.brutalHelp: Advanced forms add one charge and a delayed split fan. Every leg has a full warning; the fan leaves a marked gap down its center.
messages.boss.ratcatcher.phaseHint.0: Cross between the fixed scent lanes. Shoot the outlined sack to cancel a pack; the rats can go around cover.
messages.boss.ratcatcher.phaseHint.1: The Ratcatcher moves before each pack. Follow the new ground origin, then read the fixed scent lanes.
messages.boss.ratcatcher.brutalHelp: Advanced forms whistle a ring with a marked gap. The late phase whistles twice, turning the second gap. Breaking the sack cancels rats, not whistles.
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.phaseHint.0: Read stamps I, II, III. After III strikes, enter the green interior of the notched first seal. The green shield stops the warned volley from the two red seals, letting you keep firing. Bullets break on its rim; the outer ring counts down until shelter closes. You can also dodge outside.
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.phaseHint.1: The Clerk relocates before marking. Avoid stamp III until its notched seal turns green, then enter. The green shield stops the warned volley from the two red seals, letting you keep firing. Bullets break on its rim; the outer ring counts down until shelter closes. You can also dodge outside.
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.brutalHelp: Brutal marks five seals. Green lasts at least 3.5 seconds and remains until the final marked echo reaches its rim. Purple triangles deal double red impact damage. First contact per seal also removes 15% of current health through armor/shields and applies three seconds of poison (2 base damage each half-second) and 35% walking slow. Poison refreshes without stacking. Cleanses remove it; green shelter and invulnerability prevent application and poison damage. Dash speed is unchanged.
messages.boss.tollkeeper.phaseHint.0: Read the wheel arrow, leave its line and cross behind it. Attack during the clear recovery.
messages.boss.tollkeeper.phaseHint.1: The booth shifts before throwing. At the wall the wheel stops, then warns a newly aimed return. Read each fresh arrow.
messages.boss.tollkeeper.brutalHelp: Advanced wheels stop at banks and warn side coin sprays. The late phase adds a third leg. The wheel still occupies its own marked lane; a gap between coins is not protection from the wheel.
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.advancedDescriptio: Brutal chooses one random green number I–V at phase start and keeps it throughout phase one. Crazed chooses a fresh green number for every field. Read the notch before entering. After the marked patrol, each late advanced field locks a new random green number. Follow its fresh notch.
Brutal chooses one random green number I–V at phase start and keeps it throughout phase one. Crazed chooses a fresh green number for every field. Read the notch before entering.
After the marked patrol, each late advanced field locks a new random green number. Follow its fresh notch.
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.crazedHelp: Crazed marks ten seals. Green lasts at least five seconds and covers the final marked echoes. Black skulls remove 75% of current health once per seal activation, bypassing armor and shields but leaving at least 1 HP. Purple triangles deal double red impact damage. First contact per seal also removes 15% of current health through armor/shields and applies three seconds of poison (2 base damage each half-second) and 35% walking slow. Poison refreshes without stacking. Cleanses remove it; green shelter and invulnerability prevent application and poison damage. Dash speed is unchanged.
messages.boss.chain-marshal.phaseHint.0: The first sweep locks its aim. The barb gap does not protect you from the chain itself.
messages.boss.chain-marshal.phaseHint.1: After the marked reposition, the arms start in sequence. Each surviving anchor warns a freshly aimed reverse sweep; read the new sector before crossing.
messages.boss.chain-marshal.brutalHelp: Brutal adds gapped barb volleys from each surviving anchor. Cutting one cancels its return and unreleased repeats; already flying shots remain. Attack during the clear recovery.
messages.boss.chain-marshal.crazedHelp: Crazed retains Brutal and triples its barb budget. Later repeats add separately warned crossing angles; follow each new warning.
messages.ui.bossGuidePaused: Combat is paused while this guide is open.
messages.boss.gate-widow.phaseHint.0: Read the locked opening and the floor arrows. Each gate warns for 1.5 seconds; the pall begins 0.6 seconds later.
messages.boss.gate-widow.phaseHint.1: After the marked movement, a vertical gate and then a horizontal gate warn separately. The old set opens before the next orientation begins.
messages.boss.gate-widow.brutalHelp: Brutal adds separately warned gapped needle volleys at the opening posts. The opening is not a bullet shield. Attack during recovery.
messages.boss.gate-widow.crazedHelp: Crazed retains Brutal, triples its needle budget, adds crossing repeats and one extra fully warned gate.
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.shelterBonusHelp: While fully inside active green shelter, damage to the Clerk increases by 50%/35% in Standard, 40%/20% in Brutal and 25%/5% in Crazed, for phase one/two. This does not boost damage to other targets.
messages.boss.quarantine-clerk.domainHelp: Crazed phase two leaves two amber infinity domains per stamp batch. After a two-second warning they last for the rest of combat. Each contact removes 10% of maximum health through armor/shields and can down you. All domains share one hit per second per survivor. Green shelter and invulnerability protect.

messages.boss.black-ambulance.phaseHint.0: Follow the gold patrol. Leave the locked road before the charge. Fire during the three-second driver halt: boss damage +25%.
messages.boss.black-ambulance.phaseHint.1: The later route reverses patrol direction and dispatches twice. Every new road gets its own full warning. Wait for the final driver halt.
messages.boss.black-ambulance.brutalHelp: Brutal dispatches two/three times by phase. Each stop warns gapped door fans for at least 1.25 seconds, with 40 actual shots. Read the repeat marks before the next departure.
messages.boss.black-ambulance.crazedHelp: Crazed retains Brutal, adds a fourth late dispatch, and fires 120 shots per stop with extra crossing repeats. Every new road still warns fully.
messages.boss.matron.phaseHint.0: Read the pale escort path and the new nest warning. Cross the lullaby through its marked gap; break nests to stop their brood.
messages.boss.matron.phaseHint.1: Surviving nests relay their lullabies in numbered order. Each gap locks before release. Late broods have four minions instead of two.
messages.boss.matron.brutalHelp: Brutal adds 30 warned needles per calling nest, with alternating ports and a clear central gap. Every heading is shown before release.
messages.boss.matron.crazedHelp: Crazed keeps the first 30 Brutal needles and extends each nest volley to 90 with extra crossing repeats. Read the purple rays and remaining-wave marks.
messages.boss.alchemist.phaseHint.0: Amber triangles are acid; blue squares are alkali. Bait the opposite throw near a pool, then leave. Mixing them makes pale coolant.
messages.boss.alchemist.phaseHint.1: Vapor crosses the field. Dash through the bank or use coolant; the vapor opens around coolant.
messages.boss.alchemist.phaseHint.2: Pressure vessels swell before rupture. Make coolant beside a vessel to cool it before its marked burst.
messages.boss.alchemist.phaseHint.3: Two vapor banks cross in sequence, each with a fresh warning. Cool the vessels and keep a route through each bank.
messages.boss.alchemist.brutalHelp: Brutal links matching reagents into two timed eruptions. Neutralize either pool before the first eruption to cancel the pair.
messages.boss.alchemist.crazedHelp: Crazed retains violet catalysts: coolant quenches them and is spent; unmixed reagent erupts after a fresh warning. It adds distillation columns. Phase I: one column sends two clouds down a fixed lane. Phase II: three clouds aim again between warnings. Phase III: two columns send two each. Phase IV: three each; the last cloud flows back toward its column. Every cloud path warns for 1.8 seconds. Fumes pass over masonry, hit once per cloud and slow movement. Mix acid and alkali beside a column to cool it and stop future or pending releases. Already released clouds keep travelling. Coolant touching a cloud condenses it, then is spent after 0.9 seconds of grace. Columns cannot be shot. Keep room for the other chemistry.
messages.boss.bellringer.phaseHint.0: Two overlapping outward peals follow a warned clapper swing. Step outside its marked sector; then read both moving fronts.
messages.boss.bellringer.phaseHint.1: The Bellringer approaches a survivor before three peals and two aimed clapper swings. The pale approach path is harmless; attacks lock after arrival.
messages.boss.bellringer.phaseHint.2: Outward peals overlap an inward counterstroke. Follow the direction arrows and the fixed openings; each clapper aim locks with its own warning.
messages.boss.bellringer.phaseHint.3: Six alternating peals and three clapper swings form a carillon. Stay mobile between the independently warned strikes.
messages.boss.bellringer.brutalHelp: Brutal adds one tethered clapper to its overlapping peals. Leave the marked outbound lane. After landing, the cracked white head becomes shootable during a fresh return warning: break it to stop the return, or sidestep the returning head. The thin chain itself is harmless.
messages.boss.bellringer.crazedHelp: Crazed inherits the thrown clapper with a tougher head and deploys a second bell while the primary keeps attacking. Three or four reply fronts and a separate clapper overlap the main score. Read each source and its fixed opening; keep moving between newly aimed strikes.
